constraints.proficiency: self-reported puzzle-specific experience: novice / regular / experienced
constraints.display: actual game UI; difficulty label visible, solver class withheld
constraints.warmup: one non-assessed trial from each game's Lv3 selection; no strategy explanation before scoring
constraints.pairOrder: counterbalanced A then B vs B then A by participant parity
constraints.continuous: 20 unique level 5 puzzles not in representative or paired panels; random deterministic hash order, not optimized for solver features
constraints.independence: AI-generated notes must never appear as human observations; no blind claim for visible level labels
constraints.outcome: Comparison is provisional until completed independently; eligibility count not product attractiveness
constraints.navigate: Use the in-game Zukan on /puzzles/<game>; Zukan number is cumulative across all levels (not per-level ordinal). Legacy /puzzles/<game>/zukan redirects to game home; direct problem URL is not yet supported.

definitions.zukanNumber: sum of prior level pool counts + ordinal (1-based); unlike ordinal this is global across difficulties
definitions.pilot: water-sort and reflection as original issue; solver round comparison panels for nanpure and minesweeper as complementary validation
